```rust
fn resolve_type_in(&self, annotation: &str, params: &[String]) -> Option<Type> {
    let trimmed = annotation.trim();
    if params.iter().any(|p| p == trimmed) { return Some(Type::Param(stable_type_id(trimmed))); }
    // structural validation for user generic instances
    if let Some((base, args)) = split_generic_annotation(trimmed) {
        if !is_builtin_type_constructor(base) {
            let qualified = self.resolve_type_alias(base);
            let decl = find_type_declaration(&self.program, &qualified)?;
            if args.len() != decl.type_parameters.len() { return None; }
            // recursively validate each argument against current params
            for arg in &args { self.resolve_type_in(arg, params)?; }
        } else {
            // builtin arity
            if args.len() != builtin_arity_for(base) { return None; }
            for arg in &args { self.resolve_type_in(arg, params)?; }
        }
    }
    let param_set: HashSet<String> = params.iter().cloned().collect();
    type_from_name_with(trimmed, &self.type_aliases, &param_set).or_else(|| {...})
}
```

```rust
    let trimmed = annotation.trim();
    if let Some((base, args)) = split_generic_annotation(trimmed) {
        if let Some(expected) = builtin_type_arity(base).or_else(|| declaration arity) {
            if args.len() != expected { return Err(NXL2001 format!("type '{base}' expects {expected} type argument(s), found {}", args.len())) }
        } else if !is_builtin { return Err(NXL2004 "unknown type '{base}'") }
        for arg in args { self.resolve_type_checked(arg, span)?; } // ensures nested unknown args error
    }
    self.resolve_type(trimmed).ok_or_else(|| NXL2004 unknown type '{annotation}')
}
```

```rust
fn bind_type_arguments(
    annotation: &str,
    actual: Type,
    params: &[String],
    aliases: &HashMap<String,String>,
    bindings: &mut HashMap<String, Type>,
) {
    let ann = annotation.trim();
    if params.iter().any(|p| p == ann) {
        bindings.entry(ann.to_owned()).or_insert(actual);
        return;
    }
    if let Some((base, args)) = split_generic_annotation(ann) {
        let actual_component = |index: usize| -> Option<Type> {
            match (base, index, actual) {
                ("Array"|"List", 0, Type::Array(id)) => Some(type_from_identity(id)),
                ("Option", 0, Type::Optional(id)) => Some(type_from_identity(id)),
                ("Task", 0, Type::Task(id)) => Some(type_from_identity(id)),
                ("Channel", 0, Type::Channel(id)) => Some(type_from_identity(id)),
                ("Result", 0, Type::Result(a, _)) => Some(type_from_identity(a)),
                ("Result", 1, Type::Result(_, b)) => Some(type_from_identity(b)),
                _ => None,
            }
        };
        for (index, arg) in args.iter().enumerate() {
            if let Some(component) = actual_component(index) {
                bind(annotation=arg, component, ...);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```rust
fn bind_type_parameter(bindings: &mut HashMap<String,Type>, param: &str, ty: Type) -> Result<(), String> {
    match bindings.get(param) {
        Some(existing) if existing != &ty && !is_dynamic(*existing) && !is_dynamic(ty) =>
             Err(format!("conflicting types for type parameter '{param}': {:?} and {:?}", existing, ty)),
        Some(_) => Ok(()),
        None => { bindings.insert(param.to_owned(), ty); Ok(()) }
    }
}
```

```rust
fn resolve_field_type(&self, annotation: &str, params: &[String], bindings: &HashMap<String,Type>) -> Option<Type> {
    let ann = annotation.trim();
    if let Some(bound) = bindings.get(ann) { return Some(*bound); }
    if params.iter().any(|p| p == ann) { return Some(Type::Unknown); }
    if let Some((base, args)) = split_generic_annotation(ann) {
        // builtins -> structured ids via type_identity of resolved args
        match (base, args.len()) {
            ("Array"|"List",1) => { let t = self.resolve_field_type(args[0],params,bindings)?; return Some(Type::Array(type_identity(t))); }
            ("Option",1) => ...
            ("Task",1)/("Channel",1)
            ("Result",2) => ...
            ("Map",2) => return self.resolve_type(ann), // can't substitute; fall back
            _ => {
                // user generic: substitute args where possible, recompute Instance
                let mut resolved = Vec::new();
                for arg in &args { resolved.push(self.resolve_field_type(arg, params, bindings)?); }
                return Some(Type::Instance(stable_type_id(&self.resolve_type_alias(base)), argument_fingerprint(&resolved)));
            }
        }
    }
    self.resolve_type(ann)
}
```

1];\n                split_type_arguments(contents)\n                    .into_iter()\n                    .map(|argument| type_from_name_with(argument, aliases, params))\n                    .collect::<Option<Vec<_>>>()?;\n                return Some(Type::Tuple(stable_type_id(name)));\n            }\n            let open = name.find('<')?;\n            if !name.ends_with('>') {\n                return None;\n            }\n            let constructor = &name[..open];\n            let argument_names = split_type_arguments(&name[open + 1..name.len() - 1]);\n            let arguments = argument_names\n                .iter()\n                .map(|argument| type_from_name_with(argument, aliases, params))\n                .collect::<Option<Vec<_>>>()?;\n            match (constructor, arguments.as_slice()) {\n                (\"Array\", [_]) | (\"List\", [_]) => Some(Type::Array(stable_type_id(&keyed(\n                    argument_names[0],\n                    aliases,\n                )))),\n                (\"Option\", [_]) => Some(Type::Optional(stable_type_id(&keyed(\n                    argument_names[0],\n                    aliases,\n                )))),\n                (\"Task\", [_]) => Some(Type::Task(stable_type_id(&keyed(\n                    argument_names[0],\n                    aliases,\n                )))),\n                (\"Channel\", [_]) => Some(Type::Channel(stable_type_id(&keyed(\n                    argument_names[0],\n                    aliases,\n                )))),\n                (\"Result\", [_, _]) => Some(Type::Result(\n                    stable_type_id(&keyed(argument_names[0], aliases)),\n                    stable_type_id(&keyed(argument_names[1], aliases)),\n                )),\n                (\"Map\", [_, _]) => Some(Type::Map(stable_type_id(name))),\n                // Known containers with the wrong arity are malformed, not\n                // user-defined generic types.\n                (\"Array\" | \"List\" | \"Option\" | \"Task\" | \"Channel\" | \"Result\" | \"Map\", _) => None,\n                (base, _) => {\n                    let qualified = aliases.get(base).cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| base.to_owned());\n                    Some(Type::Instance(\n                        stable_type_id(&qualified),\n                        argument_fingerprint(&arguments),\n                    ))\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}"
```rust
}
```

`resolve_type` returns `Result<Type, ResolveError>`:

```rust
fn resolve_type(
    name: &str,
    known_types: &[String],
    aliases: &HashMap<String, String>,
    generic_arities: &HashMap<String, usize>,
    params: &[String],
) -> Result<Type, ResolveError> {
    if params.iter().any(|param| param == name) {
        return Ok(Type::Param(stable_type_id(name)));
    }
    // Validate user generic instantiation before structural resolution.
    if let Some((base, arguments)) = split_generic(name) {
        if !is_builtin_container(base) {
            match generic_arities.get(base) {
                Some(&expected) if expected != arguments.len() => {
                    return Err(ResolveError::Arity { base: base.to_owned(), expected, found: arguments.len() });
                }
                Some(_) => {}
                None => {
                    // Imported or unknown base: unknown when neither the local
                    // declarations nor the alias table knows it.
                    if !aliases.contains_key(base) {
                        return Err(ResolveError::Unknown);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        // Validate each argument recursively first (so unknown nested types
        // are reported), resolution of the whole handled below.
    }
    type_from_name_with(name, aliases, params)
        .or_else(|| aliases.get(name).map(...))
        .or_else(|| known_types.contains... )
        .ok_or(ResolveError::Unknown)
}
```

```rust
fn declared_type_arity(statement: &Statement) -> Option<(String, usize)> {
    match statement {
        Statement::TypeDeclaration(d) => Some((d.name.clone(), d.type_parameters.len())),
        Statement::TypeAlias(a) => Some((a.name.clone(), a.type_parameters.len())),
        Statement::Export(inner) => declared_type_arity(inner),

    }
}
```

Implementation:

```rust
enum TypeResolveError {
    Unknown,
    Arity { base: String, expected: usize, found: usize },
}

fn resolve_type(
    name: &str,
    known_types: &[String],
    aliases: &HashMap<String, String>,
    generic_arities: &HashMap<String, usize>,
    params: &[String],
) -> Result<Type, TypeResolveError> {
    if params.iter().any(|param| param == name) {
        return Ok(Type::Param(stable_type_id(name)));
    }
    // Validate user generic instantiations: `Base<...>`.
    if let Some(open) = name.find('<') {
        if name.ends_with('>') {
            let base = &name[..open];
            let arguments = split_type_arguments(&name[open + 1..name.len() - 1]);
            if !matches!(base, "Array" | "List" | "Option" | "Task" | "Channel" | "Result" | "Map") {
                match generic_arities.get(base) {
                    Some(&expected) if expected != arguments.len() => {
                        return Err(TypeResolveError::Arity {
                            base: base.to_owned(),
                            expected,
                            found: arguments.len(),
                        });
                    }
                    Some(_) => {}
                    None => {
                        // Imported generic types are not declared in this file;
                        // their arity is validated where they are declared.
                        if !aliases.contains_key(base) {
                            return Err(TypeResolveError::Unknown);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    type_from_name_with(name, aliases, params)
        .or_else(|| {
            aliases
                .get(name)
                .map(|qualified| Type::Generic(stable_type_id(qualified)))
        })
        .or_else(|| {
            known_types
                .iter()
                .any(|known| known == name)
                .then(|| Type::Generic(stable_type_id(name)))
        })
        .ok_or(TypeResolveError::Unknown)
}
```

Diagnostic mapping:
```rust
fn type_diagnostic(error: TypeResolveError, annotation: &str, span: Span) -> Diagnostic {
    match error {
        Unknown => Diagnostic::error("NXL2004", format!("unknown type '{annotation}'"), span),
        Arity { base, expected, found } => Diagnostic::error(
            "NXL2001",
            format!("type '{base}' expects {expected} type argument(s), found {found}"),
            span,
        ),
    }
}
```
